metadata.source: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project
ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 Global Pedological Map (250m Resolution)
metadata.reference_region: Central Valley (San Joaquin Plain), California, USA
metadata.disclaimer: SoilGrids provides 250m machine-learning spatial estimations. Use for regional planning; field-level fertilizer prescriptions require certified laboratory core sampling.

agronomic_evaluation.suitability_summary: Classified as Sandy Loam (Alfisol / Entisol (San Joaquin Valley)) with well drained sandy loam.
key_findings: Optimal pH (7.2): Excellent nutrient bio-availability across root zone for major field crops.
Balanced Sandy Loam: Favorable soil-water balance and capillary aeration for root establishment.
Healthy Organic Carbon (12.0 g/kg): Supports beneficial fungal-bacterial microbiomes and aggregate stability.
agronomic_evaluation.fertility_guidance: Recommended practice: extract 0-30cm and 30-60cm core samples to verify active nitrate (NO3-N) and Olsen phosphorus before fertilizer application.

metadata.sensor_platform: NASA MODIS (MOD13Q1) & ESA Sentinel-2 MSI Multi-Mission Synthesis
metadata.transparency_note: Calibrated historical 16-day vegetation index composite. Remote sensing reflects active photosynthetic chlorophyll absorption; ground verification recommended for pest scouting.

current_observation.stress_anomaly: None Detected (Canopy index within expected agroclimatic envelope)

interpretation_guide.classification: Water, Bare Rock, or Dry Soil

Dense Healthy Canopy (High Chlorophyll Activity / Anthesis)

drought.description: Annual precipitation (405.6mm) supports rainfed winter wheat/barley; summer crops require planned irrigation.

heat_stress.description: Peak temperatures reach 47.98°C with 8 months exceeding 32°C. Risk of flower abortion and grain desiccation.

frost_hazard.description: Extended sub-zero winter (-4.44°C minimum across 5 months). Strict frost-tolerant winter varieties or spring planting required.

excessive_rainfall.description: Peak monthly precipitation is 79.0mm. Only 1.7% of precipitation falls during summer, characteristic of Mediterranean/Continental seasonality.

climate_risks.scientific_disclaimer: Climate risk indices reflect long-term historical NASA POWER agroclimatological statistics and do not constitute an active meteorological severe weather alert.

crop_recommendations.name: Barley

limiting_factors.description: Growing season mean temperature deviates from optimal range (12.0-20.0°C).

reasons: Temperature profile presents thermal divergence from optimal requirements.
Available moisture is adequate for expected crop evapotranspiration.
Soil reaction (pH 7.2) and Sandy Loam texture provide supportive rooting conditions.
identified_risks: Heat Stress Risk: Peak summer temperatures (~44.0°C) exceed crop sensitivity threshold (30.0°C).
crop_recommendations.rotation_advice: Early harvest frees land for secondary crops or summer fallow moisture retention

previous_crop.name: Processing / Table Tomatoes
previous_crop.soil_legacy_assessment: Previous Processing / Table Tomatoes leaves potential risk of soil-borne Verticillium, Fusarium, and cyst nematodes. Strict mandatory break from any Solanaceae is required for at least 3 seasons.

agronomic_cautions: STRICT WARNING: Do not plant potatoes or tomatoes back-to-back. High risk of Late Blight, soil nematode propagation, and bacterial wilt.

recommended_rotation_sequence.name: Winter Wheat
recommended_rotation_sequence.agronomic_benefit: Cereal is a non-host to Solanaceous nematodes and fungal wilts, allowing pathogen populations to naturally decline.

recommended_rotation_sequence.name: Chickpeas
recommended_rotation_sequence.agronomic_benefit: Rebuilds biological soil health and fixes nitrogen while maintaining disease break.
